docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY USA COMSA HAIR CORP. AS TO DEFENDANT O'DEA, CHIEKO ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-11-2016 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
COPYING FEES (5 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF USA COMSA HAIR CORP.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERIVICE $ 68.95 SERVED JUN-16-2016, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT O'DEA, CHIEKO

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-11-2016 IS OFF CALENDAR, TRANSFER TO LIMITED/UNLIMITED JURISDICTION (SF). APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF'S REPRESENTATIVE KYOKO KUDO, VICE PRESIDENT OF USA COMSA HAIR CORP. PHYLLIS OGATA WAS PLACED UNDER OATH AND SERVED AS JAPANESE SPEAKING INTERPRETER FOR MS. KUDO. ALSO PRESENT WAS DEFENDANT CHIEKO O'DEA, WHO WAS ASSISTED AT TODAY'S HEARING BY COURT CERTIFIED JAPENESE SPEAKING INTERPRETER ERI MINOURA. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. IN ACCORDANCE WITH CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE SECTION 116.390, THE COURT GRANTS DEFENDANT'S REQUEST TO TRANSFER THE PRESENT SMALL CLAIMS ACTION TO SFSC UNLIMITED JURISDICTION TO BE HEARD IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE MATTER ENTITLED CHIEKO O'DEA VS. USA COMSA HAIR CORP, A CALIFORNIA CORPORATION, DBA ARTY HAIR SALON, SAN FRANCISCO SUPERIOR COURT NUMBER CGC-16-553452. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED.
